entities.name: Vladimir Yeryomin

entities.summary: Vladimir Arkadyevich Yeryomin is a Soviet and Russian stage, film and voice actor, screenwriter, producer and television presenter. He was awarded the Merited Artist of the Russian Federation in 2006.
